The amount included certain expenses not attributable to a business segment, such as costs related to certain support functions, corporate executives, and operating lease assets, and included amortization expense associated with intangible assets recorded as a result of acquisitions.

For the three months ended September 30, 2026, the amount included a $38 million charge attributable to Completion and Production, a $54 million charge attributable to Drilling and Evaluation, and a $15 million charge attributable to Corporate and other. For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, the amount included a $45 million credit attributable to Completion and Production, a $38 million charge attributable to Drilling and Evaluation, and a $19 million charge attributable to Corporate and other. For the three months ended September 30, 2025, the amount included a $252 million charge attributable to Completion and Production and a $140 million charge attributable to Drilling and Evaluation. For the nine months ended September 30, 2025, the amount included a $453 million charge attributable to Completion and Production, a $225 million charge attributable to Drilling and Evaluation, and a $70 million charge attributable to Corporate and other. See Notes to Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements, Note 2 for further discussion on impairments and other charges.
During the three and nine months ended September 30, 2025, we incurred a charge of $23 million due to the impairment of an investment in Argentina.

Of the 7,571,849 shares purchased during the three-month period ended September 30, 2026, 221,929 were acquired from employees in connection with the settlement of income tax and related benefit withholding obligations arising from vesting in restricted stock grants. These shares were not part of a publicly announced program to repurchase common stock.

Our Board of Directors has authorized a program to repurchase a specified dollar amount of our common stock from time to time. On July 21, 2014, our Board of Directors announced that it had approved an increase in the total available outstanding authorization for repurchases to $6.0 billion. Approximately $1.5 billion remained authorized for repurchases as of September 30, 2026. From the inception of this program in February of 2006 through September 30, 2026, we repurchased approximately 342 million shares of our common stock for a total cost of approximately $12.6 billion. The program may be terminated or suspended at any time and does not have a specified expiration date.
